summary: Kinder Morgan, Inc. and multiple subsidiaries (El Paso Natural Gas, Tennessee Gas Pipeline, Colorado Interstate Gas, El Paso Tennessee Pipeline, Kinder Morgan Energy Partners, Kinder Morgan GP, El Paso LLC) filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to an existing shelf registration (333-275130). This is a routine takedown of debt or equity securities, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing complies with the Securities Act of 1933 for general corporate purposes.
